note: Set A provides cleaner value extraction, correctly separating numerical values from text labels (e.g., '1/2" in' vs '1/2 PL TYP'), whereas Set B frequently includes label text in the value field, creating misread claims. However, Set A misses the base plate specification ('PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2') which Set B correctly captures. Set A is preferred due to higher data integrity and fewer incorrect claims, despite the missing component.
remarks: Set B's misread values (e.g., '3 DIA', '1/2 PL TYP') significantly reduce usability despite better coverage. Set A's missing base plate is a notable omission but the extracted data is more reliable.
